import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages; w['late']=w.year>=1876
print(w.groupby(['genre','late']).r.agg(['mean','count']).unstack().round(3))
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack()
  return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
print('est',est(w))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
cells=[x.r.values for _,x in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
keys=list(w.groupby(['genre','late']).groups.keys())
bs=[]
for i in range(4000):
  m={k:rng.choice(v,len(v)).mean() for k,v in zip(keys,cells)}
  G=set(k[0] for k in keys);bs.append(np.mean([m[(g,True)]-m[(g,False)] for g in G]))
print('ci',np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for k,v in [('high',w.date_confidence=='high'),('nolow',w.date_confidence!='low'),('UK',w.origin=='UK'),('US',w.origin=='US'),('unk',w.origin=='unknown'),('1850-1900',w.year.between(1850,1900))]:
  print(k,round(est(w[v]),4))
print(w.groupby('decade').r.agg(['mean','count']).round(3).T)
print(w.author_key.value_counts().head(3))
"
